user.title: Blockly Automations
user.description: Adds an "Automationen" sidebar panel that shows your automations as blocks and saves them back as normal Home Assistant automations.

abort.already_configured: Blockly Automations is already set up.

restart_required.title: Blockly Automations: restart required
restart_required.description: Version {version} has been installed and contains changes that only take effect after a restart of Home Assistant. Restart Home Assistant when convenient (Settings → System → Restart). The editor itself already uses the new version.

data_description.ui_mode: Home Assistant dialogs: values are chosen in the original Home Assistant windows (recommended for beginners). Blockly blocks: everything is set directly inside the blocks with searchable lists, all services and device blocks in the toolbox – like the Blockly editor in ioBroker.
data_description.block_set: Version A: exactly what the Home Assistant automation contains. Version B: additional ioBroker-style blocks such as global variables; Blockly creates helpers for them on request. Both save normal Home Assistant automations; you can switch back at any time.
